ModMetaData.name: Strata
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
My Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv Site (no Discord): https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/strata.html Roadmap: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/strata-roadmap.html Issues: https://github.com/AzraelGodKing/rimworld_mods/issues
Dig down. Build up. One colony — many floors.
Carve rock under your base, frame a roof deck above it, and let colonists treat every linked level as home. Work, food, sleep, hauling, medicine, combat, and construction commute through the shafts on their own.
Version 3.1.0. RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony. Odyssey optional (gravship stacks only). Safe to add mid-save. Do not run alongside AASB or MultiFloors.
DIG DOWN - Research digging down, build an excavated stairwell, open a full-size rock level under your map - Deeper floors need deep excavation; extra shafts join the same level - Thick rock roof — no drop pods, mortars, or weather from the sky - Elevators: compact 1x1 cars (power to descend; ride up even if power fails)
BUILD UP - Research building up, frame a tower stairwell or tower elevator - Opens outdoor Level +N as a roof deck — walk and build where the floor below is roofed - Expand roofs downstairs to grow the deck; Page Up / Page Down jump floors - See-below: look through open sky / see-through deck into the map underneath — select, float menus, live pawns
ONE BASE, MANY FLOORS Other multi-level mods leave each floor an island. Strata's job relay treats the column as one settlement: - Idle colonists notice mining, blueprints, hauling, and bills on other levels and walk the stairs - Hungry / sleepy pawns find meals and beds across the stack - Haulers deliver through shafts; force-build pulls materials from linked stockpiles - Combined resources can sum the column for the readout and build menu - Work and Schedule can list colonists on every linked floor - Mental breaks, raiders, and visitors chase / commute through shafts No micromanagement: you designate, they commute.
CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT Pawns, turrets, and mortars can fire through open shafts and sky holes (Combat Extended guns included). Auto-engage keeps decks and underfloors in the fight without hopping maps by hand.
HEAT, SMOKE, AND AIR - Stairwells exchange temperature — heat rises fast, cold pools below - Buoyant gases rise through open shafts; heavy gases sink - Optional atmosphere sim (gases default off for performance): smoke, deep gas, O2 / CO2 in sealed rooms - Oxygen pumps, scrubbers, shaft exchangers, canary cages, gas overlay
LIVING BELOW Research living below for shoring, gas airlocks, ore hoists, fungus farms, sump pumps, mine lamps, bellows, lime scrubbers, deep-gas wells, and smokeless generators.
POWER AND PIPES UP THE SHAFT - Elevators and shaft power conduits tie grids between floors — live surplus feeds demand without a battery on every level - Soft fluid junctions (when those mods load): Dubs Bad Hygiene, Central Heating, Rimatomics, helixien gas, Vanilla Temperature ducts, chemfuel, crude oil
GRAVSHIP STACKS (ODYSSEY) Ship-only stairwells open A+/B+ pockets that travel on launch and reattach on landing. Soft-compatible with Vanilla Gravship Expanded — Chapter 1. Colony dig/tower stairs cannot sit on substructure — use gravship shafts on the ship.
EVENTS THAT KNOW WHICH WAY IS UP Sky threats stay upstairs. Below: infestations, cave-ins, gas pockets, firestorms, deep sieges, cave breakthroughs, rich ore, burrowing raiders. World sites (collapsed mine, sealed vault, geothermal vent, sunken ruins) and optional ancient surface stairheads. Seal a stairwell to contain gas or bugs — and your own colonists.
PERFORMANCE Every level is a full map matching your map size. On large maps (300x300+) each opened floor costs real FPS. Vacant-level and background throttles help; prefer a smaller map if you dig deep. Default level cap +/-2 (Unlimited off).
TIPS - Leave pillars in big halls — thick rock roofs collapse when unsupported - Keep a stockpile near the stairs on each floor for hauling - Stairwells cannot be torn down while anyone is still on the linked level (orphan / unlinked shafts can be cleared) - Rename levels in the Levels tab - Before removing the mod: bring everyone up, haul what you care about, deconstruct every stairwell - Tall towers from other mods keep normal sky — Strata roof decks (A+) only open when you build a Strata tower stairwell or elevator - Digging under a mountain (or building a tower over one) should leave mineable rock; Biomes! hollow digs fall back to Strata rock fill, and A+ over mountain mass is diggable rock not empty deck - Don't dig Strata shafts on temporary quest maps (Ancient Urban Ruins, world sites) — use their own floors; Strata is for your home colony - Cave mods like Deep And Deeper (and Anomaly undercaves) are ignored by Strata's cross-level relays by default — an optional setting can extend relays into their caves too
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Odyssey optional.
